+"""Dual read/write validation: CSV (source of truth for this check) vs DB.
+
+For every row in customers.csv, verify the matching row exists in
+customers.db with identical values. Also reports DB rows that have no
+CSV counterpart (reverse-direction discrepancy).
+"""
+
+import csv
+import sqlite3
+
+CSV_PATH = "customers.csv"
+DB_PATH = "customers.db"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    with open(CSV_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+        csv_rows = {
+            int(r["id"]): (r["name"], r["email"], r["city"])
+            for r in csv.DictReader(f)
+        }
+
+    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+    db_rows = {
+        row[0]: (row[1], row[2], row[3])
+        for row in conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email, city FROM customers")
+    }
+    conn.close()
+
+    discrepancies = []
+
+    # Forward: every CSV row must exist in DB with matching values
+    for cid, (name, email, city) in sorted(csv_rows.items()):
+        if cid not in db_rows:
+            discrepancies.append(f"MISSING in DB: id={cid} ({name!r} not found)")
+        elif db_rows[cid] != (name, email, city):
+            discrepancies.append(
+                f"MISMATCH id={cid}: csv={ (name, email, city)!r} db={db_rows[cid]!r}"
+            )
+        else:
+            print(f"OK  id={cid}: {name} <{email}> [{city}]")
+
+    # Reverse: DB rows with no CSV counterpart
+    for cid, values in sorted(db_rows.items()):
+        if cid not in csv_rows:
+            discrepancies.append(f"EXTRA in DB: id={cid} {values!r} (no CSV row)")
+
+    print(f"\nCSV rows: {len(csv_rows)} | DB rows: {len(db_rows)}")
+    if discrepancies:
+        print(f"DISCREPANCIES FOUND ({len(discrepancies)}):")
+        for d in discrepancies:
+            print(" -", d)
+    else:
+        print("All rows validated: no discrepancies.")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
